intervention.note: single factor: 1.0*KL(base||policy) over the action_valid rows of arm B only

split.rule: one group = base + mirror, atomic; within each family the groups are ordered by group name (candidate index) and alternate train/validation starting with train at index 0; the two F2 groups therefore give one train and one validation group

storage.dtype: uint8 (the renderer output verbatim, never cast to float on disk)
storage.container: npz deflate for the pixel regions, torch.save (xb) for history/labels
storage.scale: uint8 -> float32 /255 happens only at load through vision.regions_to_batch
storage.hud: hud_score/hud_status are byte-identical across all 80 decisions (asserted per event); stored once as [1,3,H,W,C] and expanded to 80 rows at load, so the values are identical while the 80 redundant copies are not written
storage.why: a float32 copy of the same content is 4x larger and adds nothing: every consumer divides by 255 immediately

data.history_semantics: actual executed candidate (ACTION_MAP), previous_hold 2, frame_delta 2, option BOS3, target_valid false, history_valid from row 1; no teacher target or option is ever fed as input
data.label_semantics: action_positive = the one-hot of the single successful teacher route first action; action_valid = teacher_verified; nothing else

paired.note: delta = anchor(B) minus control(A) on the same seed and the same 14 events; positive means the KL anchor kept more successes

limitations: n=3 seeds and 7 validation groups; the 14 validation events collapse to 7 geometries because a mirror is not an independent sample
F2 validation is a single group (2 events) built on two nearly identical worlds (start_x 204 vs 208), so an F2 validation number is not a rate
the labels come from a rule/planner teacher that is handed the real world geometry, not from human play and not from a learned policy; "distillation" here means fitting that one route
the F1 win condition is exact parking inside a 12-20 px gap and the F3 win condition is a timed threshold crossing; neither is tactical understanding
the data is synthetic fixed-y, two-frame actions, no shot, no bomb, no real TH08 pixels
this round produces research heads only: no formal gate, no deployable checkpoint, no game
